NEAREST_NEIGHBOR_CONTEXT_DIAGNOSTICS.distance_input: exact float32 transformed observation 2*x-1, promoted to float64 for Euclidean L2 calculations
NEAREST_NEIGHBOR_CONTEXT_DIAGNOSTICS.directed_pair_definition: for every Ei != Ej, each source state contributes its nearest state in Ej; reverse directions are separately counted
NEAREST_NEIGHBOR_CONTEXT_DIAGNOSTICS.within_nn_definition: nearest non-self neighbor for each transition, p95 computed within each episode
NEAREST_NEIGHBOR_CONTEXT_DIAGNOSTICS.direct_context_test_availability_rule_fi: available iff overlap-like count >=30, fraction >=0.01, and present in >=3 distinct unordered realization pairs

overlap_like.interpretation_boundary: realized RTG disagreement is noisy sample-return evidence; it cannot prove representation insufficiency

rules_used.state_sufficient: mean macro train Corr>=0.6, mean heldout Corr>=0.5, at least 4/6 heldout Corr>0.5, median heldout StdRatio>=0.1
rules_used.train_high: mean macro train Corr>=0.5 and at least 4/6 folds >=0.5
rules_used.heldout_low_large_gap: mean heldout Corr<0.3 and mean macro-train-minus-heldout gap>=0.3
rules_used.direct_conflict_test_availability: overlap-like count>=30, fraction>=1%, and >=3 unordered episode pairs
rules_used.local_return_inconsistency: direct test available and at least half of overlap-like pairs have abs_delta_rtg_z>1; remains sample-return evidence only
rules_used.underconverged: mean step-200 macro train Corr<0.5 and median step100-to200 macro train Corr increase>0.05
rules_used.current_predictability_weak: mean step-200 macro train Corr<0.3 and median step100-to200 increase<=0.05
